subject: FirstLight: Customer Spotlight — Shoot itinerary, release review & script signoff
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: FirstLight: Customer Spotlight — Shoot itinerary, release review & script signoff

Team —

Following up on the FirstLight customer reference that Sales closed last month. They signed up for a short customer spotlight (approx. 5–7 minutes) to highlight their ROI with Redwood Inferencing. The proposed shoot date is Monday, 14 Jun (on-site at FirstLight HQ, SF).

Key asks right now:
- Review the attached script (v3) for flow and approve or leave line edits by EOD Fri 07 Jun.
- Confirm release form language is acceptable — we need a signed release (DocuSign link) before the day of the shoot.
- Ops: Tessa/Dev, can you confirm audio & camera crew availability for 14 Jun and list any gear needs or backups?

Attachments I'm planning to share with FirstLight in the outreach: FirstLight_Spotlight_Script_v3.docx, Release_FirstLight_Spotlight.pdf, FirstLight_Shotlist_v2.xlsx

I'll draft the outreach to Alyssa and Jordan and include the Drive + DocuSign links; want to make sure we avoid any brand or privacy issues up front (Grace — tagging you for brand/comms review).

Thanks —
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Looks good — I can cover DP for the day. Quick notes:
- We'll bring two lav mics + handheld; will pack spare SD/SSD and a backup battery kit.
- Recommend a 2-camera setup (A: interview, B: angled B-roll).
- Wardrobe: ask Alyssa if they prefer branded polos or business casual (we can bring neutral drape).

If Dev can handle the local file ingest and checksum on-site, we should be fine.

—Tessa

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Cheng <alyssa.cheng@firstlight.com>
Cc: Jordan Park <jordan.park@firstlight.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: FirstLight customer spotlight — proposed itinerary, script & release for signoff

Hi Alyssa —

Great to connect last week — excited to capture FirstLight's story. We're targeting Monday, 14 Jun for an on-site shoot at your SF office. Attached are three items for review:
1) FirstLight_Spotlight_Script_v3.docx — proposed interview script and suggested B-roll moments.
2) Release_FirstLight_Spotlight.pdf — standard talent and location release; editable if you need legal edits.
3) FirstLight_Shotlist_v2.xlsx — proposed shots and time estimates (30–45 mins on-camera).

Logistics we need from you:
- Confirm the primary on-camera participant(s) and whether they'll sign releases before/at the shoot.
- Confirm a quiet room for interview + access to power and AC for our gear.
- Any brand guidelines we should follow (logo placement, product mentions, disclaimers).

Deadlines: please sign the release by Mon 07 Jun and provide script signoff by Fri 07 Jun so we can lock crew and call sheets.

Links:
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbcDefGhIJkl-firstlight-spotlight
- DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/FirstLight-Spotlight-Release
- Proposed prep call: Thu, 10 Jun 10:00 AM PT (I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm availability)

If on-site doesn't work, we can switch to a short studio day at a nearby facility; we'll cover facility costs.

Best,
Kimberly
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference

[Attachments: FirstLight_Spotlight_Script_v3.docx (docx), Release_FirstLight_Spotlight.pdf (pdf), FirstLight_Shotlist_v2.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Alyssa Cheng <alyssa.cheng@firstlight.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Park <jordan.park@firstlight.com>, FirstLight Marketing <marketing@firstlight.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FirstLight customer spotlight — proposed itinerary, script & release for signoff

Thanks, Kimberly — and thanks for sending these over. A few quick thoughts from our side:

- We love the narrative arc in the script but would like the opening to call out specific ROI numbers (revenue uplift %, reduced latency) — I marked a couple of spots in the script where we can insert figures.
- We're happy with 5–7 minutes total runtime.
- On-site works better for us so we can show our operations floor and do some product B-roll; we can guarantee a quiet room for interview between 9–11 AM.
- Regarding releases: we'll need to run the PDF by our legal team. Can you confirm whether the release allows limited excerpts for paid ads? Our marketing team is particularly interested in that clause.
- Attached: FirstLight_Brand_Guidelines.pdf (logo lockups + approved color palette). Also please confirm if your team will mask any customer data appearing on-screen (we prefer anonymized screens for any dashboards).

We can sign the release via DocuSign once legal approves — aim to have someone assigned by Fri 04 Jun.

Appreciate you coordinating logistics — Jordan will work with you on site access.

Best,
Alyssa Cheng
Director, Strategic Partnerships — FirstLight Health
alyssa.cheng@firstlight.com

[Attachment stub: FirstLight_Brand_Guidelines.pdf (pdf)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Cheng <alyssa.cheng@firstlight.com>, Jordan Park <jordan.park@firstlight.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FirstLight customer spotlight — proposed itinerary, script & release for signoff

All — quick update after Alyssa's notes. Action items and plan:

Production/Logistics (Tessa/Dev)
- Confirmed: on-site at FirstLight, interview window 9:00–11:00 AM on Mon, 14 Jun. Crew call 7:30 AM for setup.
- Gear list: 2x cameras, 2x lavs, 1x boom, backup SSDs, 1x gimbal for quick B-roll. (Tessa will bring production_kit_list).
- Dev to manage ingest/checksum and handoff.

Script/Comms (Kimberly/Grace)
- We'll update script to add a metrics-first opening and a three-bullet ROI callout. Draft v4 will be shared by Fri 04 Jun.
- Grace: please review FirstLight_Brand_Guidelines.pdf and confirm any logo/mention constraints.

Legal/Release (Kimberly)
- I've asked Alyssa to route the release to legal; we agreed they will assign by Fri 04 Jun. We'll accept reasonable edits but must retain basic permissions for case study use and limited social amplification.

Prep call
- Proposed: Thu, 10 Jun 10:00 AM PT (calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=firstlight-spotlight-prep) — agenda: run script v4, shotlist timing, legal questions.

Attachments included here: FirstLight_Shotlist_v2.xlsx (updated with timing), Release_FirstLight_Spotlight.pdf (marked for legal), FirstLight_Spotlight_Script_v4_draft.docx (will send shortly).

I'll follow up with the calendar invite and the v4 script by EOD Fri.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turn from everyone.

Kimberly
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
